name: brain-trail-v2
description: A pane beside the chat that shows what this Claude Code session puts in its context: a map of the files it moves through, the list of every file and why it is there, and a gauge that tells you when to compact or start a new session

autoOpen.title: Open by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts. Off: type /brain-trail to open it.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane at first open (en or fr). It can be switched in the pane.
